# STEP 0: Establish assessment period:

```{r Years 2018-2025}
START_EVAL_PERIOD= 2018
END_EVAL_PERIOD= 2025
```

# STEP 1: Read in all habitat data ------------------------------

```{r Read in habitat services data}
# PRO
PRO_Scores0<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/PRO_Scores_1.1/PRO_Scores_df_Nov032026.csv")
PRO_Scores<- PRO_Scores0 %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, PRO_score, PRO_n_habitats= n_habitats, PRO_habitats= habitats)

# FIL
FIL_Scores0<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/FIL_Scores_1.1/FIL_Scores_df_Nov032026.csv")
FIL_Scores<- FIL_Scores0 %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, FIL_score, FIL_n_habitats= n_habitats, FIL_habitats= habitats)

# SEQ
SEQ_Scores0<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/SEQ_Scores_1.1/SEQ_Scores_df_Nov032026.csv")
SEQ_Scores<- SEQ_Scores0 %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, SEQ_score, SEQ_n_habitats= n_habitats, SEQ_habitats= habitats)

```

# STEP 2: CALCULATE HS SCORES (i.e., current status) ------------------------------

```{r Merge all together for HS_Scores0}
colnames(PRO_Scores)
colnames(FIL_Scores)
colnames(SEQ_Scores)

HS_Scores0<- PRO_Scores %>%
  left_join(
    FIL_Scores,
    by= c("rgn_name", "rgn_id", "year")
  )


HS_Scores0<- HS_Scores0 %>%
  left_join(
    SEQ_Scores,
    by= c("rgn_name", "rgn_id", "year")
  )

```

```{r Create HS_Scores}
HS_Scores <- HS_Scores0 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Average the 3 scores to get final OHI score
    HS_score = round(mean(c(PRO_score, FIL_score, SEQ_score), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    HS_habitats = paste(
      sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(
        na.omit(c(PRO_habitats, FIL_habitats, SEQ_habitats)),
        ", "
      )))),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    HS_n_habitats = length(unique(unlist(strsplit(
      na.omit(c(PRO_habitats, FIL_habitats, SEQ_habitats)),
      ", "
    ))))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

dim(HS_Scores)
# 207 obs.,  15 vars.

# NOTE TO SELF: Gapfilled from 2022-2025 using 2021 values as this is the last year where we have data across all four habitat types.
# Ask team about this. I think Mel's functions will circumvent this issue - EMF.

```

# STEP 3: PLOT HS SCORES ------------------------------

```{r Load in HS_Scores as needed}
HS_Scores<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/HS_Scores_df_Nov042026.csv")
# 207 obs.,  15 vars.

```

```{r Merge Region_Key to HS_Scores}

# Make sure to order the regions:
REGION_ORDER <- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf",
  "Western Midriff Islands",
  "Western Central Gulf",
  "Western Southern Gulf",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands",
  "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Southeastern Gulf"
)

HS_Scores <- HS_Scores %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_name = factor(
      rgn_name,
      levels = REGION_ORDER
    )
  )

```

```{r Plot HS_Scores}
# Region colors
REGION_COLORS<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

HS_Scores_OverTime<- HS_Scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_name)) %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVAL_PERIOD, year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = HS_score,
    color = rgn_name
  )) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ rgn_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "HS Scores by Region",
    subtitle = "Average of PRO, FIL, and SEQ sub-scores",
    caption = "updated: Nov 04 2026",
    y = "HS Score (from 0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  ylim(0, 101) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = REGION_COLORS) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

HS_Scores_OverTime

```

```{r Save as PNG}
ggsave(

  width = 12,

  dpi = 300
)
```

## TABLE:
```{r Generate table for HS_Scores in 2025}

# Create 2025 table:
HS_Scores.2025 <- HS_Scores %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  select(
    rgn_id,
    rgn_name,
    SEQ_score,
    FIL_score,
    PRO_score,
    HS_score
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SEQ_score = round(SEQ_score, 0),
    FIL_score = round(FIL_score, 0),
    PRO_score = round(PRO_score, 0),
    HS_score = round(HS_score, 0)
  )


# Create the formatted table for display
HS_Scores.2025_ktable <- HS_Scores.2025 %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c("OHI Scores – Current Status (2025)" = 6))

HS_Scores.2025_ktable

```

```{r Save HS_Scores.2025 as csv}
# Save as CSV:
write.csv(
  HS_Scores.2025,
  "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/Website_Viz/HS_and_SubScores.2025_table_Nov042026.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r Map HS_Scores}
# Format the rgn_id column for proper merging:

ohi_habitat_current_status <- ohi_regions %>%
  left_join(
    HS_Scores %>%
      filter(year == 2025) %>% # Filter scores for 2025
    by = "rgn_id"
  )

tmap_mode("plot")

HS_Score.2025_map <- 
  tm_shape(ohi_habitat_current_status %>% filter(location == "land")) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +
  
  tm_shape(ohi_habitat_current_status %>% filter(location == "marine")) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "HS_score",
    palette = "RdYlGn",
    alpha = 0.8,
    title = "HS Score (2025)",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  )
```
